The chart displays three distinct data series: “Административни” (Administrative), “Други” (Other), and “Жилищни” (Residential), each represented by a different colored line. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis represents the number of permits issued, with values ranging from approximately 4,000 to over 8,000. The chart includes numerical labels for each data point on all three lines, indicating the exact number of permits for that year and category. The “Жилищни” (Residential) line, shown in gray, consistently has the highest values throughout the period, peaking at 8,169 in 2022. The “Други” (Other) line, shown in orange, generally follows a similar trend but remains below the Residential line, with a notable dip to 3,944 in 2020. The “Административни” (Administrative) line, shown in blue, consistently has the lowest values, ranging from 156 in 2013 to a peak of 187 in 2014, and ending at 70 in 2022. The chart uses a grid background for easier reading of the values.
